people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished.” He bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.
translations.bsb: When Jesus had received the sour wine, He said, “It is finished.” And bowing His head, He yielded up His spirit.
translations.kjv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
translations.asv: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.
